class.name: aubo_e5_hardware/AuboE5Hardware
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for the AUBO E5 6-DOF arm. Two SDK ServiceInterface connections: conn_control_ (TCP2CAN streaming, RIB flow control, send thread only) and conn_status_ (status push callbacks, safety IO, board/tool IO, stop primitives, IO async thread only).

class.name: aubo_e5_hardware/AuboE5SimHardware
class.description: Controller-board simulator for the AUBO E5 passthrough pipeline (ursim equivalent): same interface contract, transfer state machine, quintic resampling and a virtual interface board consuming one 5 ms point per cycle. No SDK, no real arm required.
